claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance.sourceFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing resistance atom only models resistance by damage type. This item grants resistance based on attack source: attacks made with ranged weapons.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this Shield, you have Resistance to damage from attacks made with Ranged weapons.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: redirect_attack_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The curse passively intercepts a qualifying ranged-weapon attack targeting a nearby creature and replaces that target with the cursed bearer before attack resolution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.
